title: shop/README.md at main · Shopify/shop
snippet:
# shop
`shop` lets agents search millions of stores, build carts, check out and pay with the shopper's Shop account, and track orders. When a store has no agent checkout, the shopper can approve a purchase on Shop and the agent gets a one-time credential to pay at the site's own checkout.

## Install
```
npm install --global @shopify/shop@latest
shop skill --install
```
Installs the `shop` command, then teaches your agent when and how to use it. Then ask your agent:
> Find three rain jackets under US$100 that ship to the US.
A full purchase, from search to tracking, takes five commands:
```
shop search "trail running shoes" --ships-to US --limit 3
shop cart create --shop example-store.com --variant gid://shopify/ProductVariant/1001 --quantity 1
shop checkout create --shop example-store.com --cart gid://shopify/Cart/…
shop checkout complete gid://shopify/Checkout/… --shop example-store.com --instrument '…'
shop order search "trail running shoes"
```

Sign-in is optional: search, carts, and checkouts work without it. Signing in to Shop adds:
- Search results ranked using the shopper's own history.
- Carts and checkouts that arrive with the shopper's saved address and payment preference filled in.
- The account, checkout completion, order, and spend-request commands in the sections below.

The CLI is a client of Shop's MCP server at `https://mcp.shop.com/`. Apart from sign-in, each command above calls one of its tools:
- Most commands send a single `tools/call`. `--patch` reads the checkout before it writes, and `--wait` polls.
- The CLI adds argument parsing, sign-in, and the JSON envelope.
To see the requests, or to call a tool by its MCP name:
```
shop checkout create --shop example-store.com --cart gid://shopify/Cart/… --dry-run    # the exact request, unsent
shop cart get gid://shopify/Cart/… --shop example-store.com --as curl                  # the exact request, as curl
shop call search_catalog --arguments '{"catalog":{"query":"rain jacket","pagination":{"limit":3}}}'   # any tool by MCP name
shop tools                                                                              # every command, its tool, its schema
```
To use the server without the CLI:
- Connect an MCP host to `https://mcp.shop.com/` to access the same tools. Sign-in goes through the host's OAuth flow, against the same Shop account, and the tools behave as they do in the CLI.
For Claude Code, install the native plugin:
```
claude plugin marketplace add Shopify/shop
claude plugin inst

title: shopify.dev/changelog/posts/add-shopping-and-shop-pay-checkout-to-any-agent-with-shop-mcp
snippet:
Shop MCP lets your agent or app search Shopify Catalog, build carts, and complete Shop Pay checkout through a single MCP connection. It works with over 1 billion products in Shopify Catalog and doesn't require an API key for search. Nothing changes for existing Catalog API integrations, and no action is required.
## What changed
Shop MCP is live at `https://mcp.shop.com`, with a skill description at `https://mcp.shop.com/skill.md` that MCP-compatible agents can read. One connection gives your agent tools, grouped into a few main flows:
* **Search and product details:** `search_catalog`, `lookup_catalog`, and `get_product` read from Shopify Catalog.
* **Sign-in with Shop:** the shopper signs in once, and search tools use their saved preferences.
* **Carts and checkout on Shopify stores:** your agent builds a cart and creates a checkout at the store that sells the product. Carts and checkout work without sign-in. With a signed-in shopper, checkout can use their saved addresses and Shop Pay, and your agent completes the purchase with `complete_checkout` after the shopper confirms the total and payment method.
* **Orders:** for a signed-in shopper, your agent finds orders and tracking with `search_orders`.
The `shop` CLI calls the same server from your terminal so you can try a search before you write any code:
```bash
npm install -g @shopify/shop
shop search "ceramic coffee dripper"
```
Each result shows the store, the price, and whether it's in stock. Replace the query with a product your agent sells to see the shape of the data your agent receives.
Orders placed through your agent appear in the merchant's Shopify admin like any other order. There are no webhooks at launch, so you need to poll `get_checkout` for checkout status.
## Who's affected
Developers who build or configure MCP-compatible agents or tools can use Shop MCP. If you use the existing Catalog API directly, your current integrations keep working without changes.

No action is required for existing integrations. To start using Shop MCP:
1. Install the `shop` CLI and run `shop search` with a query to check results from your terminal.
2. Point your coding agent at `https://mcp.shop.com/skill.md`, or add `https://mcp.shop.com` as an MCP server in your agent's config.
3. To pay with Shop Pay, have the shopper sign in with Shop. MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT run sign-in for you, and your own code can use the device flow.

title: shopify.dev/docs/agents/catalog/storefront-catalog
snippet:
# Storefront Catalog MCP
The Storefront Catalog MCP server enables AI agents to search and discover products from a single merchant's catalog, helping buyers find and purchase products from that store.
Storefront Catalog MCP implements the [UCP Catalog capability](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/specification/shopping/catalog/) and its [MCP binding](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/specification/shopping/catalog/mcp/). The names, request and response shapes of tools conform to the [UCP specification](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/specification/shopping/catalog/).
The same endpoint also implements the [UCP Location capability](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/specification/common/location/) and its [MCP binding](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/specification/common/location/mcp/), so agents can find the merchant's physical stores.
## When to use Storefront Catalog MCP
Use Storefront Catalog MCP whenever buyer intent and query are scoped to a single merchant. For example, use Storefront Catalog MCP when building a storefront AI agent. For cross-merchant product discovery, use [Global Catalog MCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/catalog/global-catalog). To find the merchant's stores, use the [location tools](#location-tools).
***
## Use with the AI Toolkit
The [Shopify AI Toolkit](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/ai-toolkit) [installs](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/ucp#install-the-ucp-cli) the `ucp` skill, which lets agents in Cursor, Claude Code, and other compatible IDEs scope catalog operations to a single merchant. Ask your assistant in natural language (`"search nike.com for running shoes"`) and the skill picks the right [UCP CLI](https://github.com/Shopify/ucp-cli) command, or pass `--business <merchant-url>` on any `ucp catalog` command directly in a terminal.
Use `--input-schema` against any of these commands to fetch the merchant's live input schema before composing a payload.
##### Search this storefront
```bash
ucp catalog search --business https://{shop}.example.com \
--set /query='cold brew' \
--view :compact \
--format md
```
##### Lookup by IDs
```bash
ucp catalog lookup --business https://{shop}.example.com \
--set '/ids/0=gid://shopify/ProductVariant/12345'
```
##### Get product
```bash
ucp catalog get_product gid://shopify/Product/67890 \
--business https://{shop}.example.com \
--set '/selected/0={"name":"Bag size","label":"12 oz"}'
```
***
